issues.title: Runtime style error
issues.body:
In the debug console we're displaying a warning for `rcb` elements:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/176149574-f6039d07-1bc4-47a2-a86d-0ccb7c0e0a1f.png)

It doesn't really bother me, but it's cluttering the console.

Steps to reproduce:
* run wargame
* log into `small-wargame` as `White` - `Game Control`.
* click on an information marker
* warning appears on console

comments.body: These warnings are making it difficult to debug issue #1628.  Ian should revisit that once this issue is complete.
